title: Mix Forcing: Causal Pre-Training via Mixture Attention for Interactive World Models
title_zh: Mix Forcing：基于混合注意力的因果预训练用于交互式世界模型

paragraphs.en: While interactive video world models require autoregressive generation, directly adapting pretrained bidirectional video diffusion models into autoregressive ones with teacher forcing can disrupt their visual priors and degrade autoregressive generation quality. In this paper, we introduce Mix Forcing , a causal pre-training paradigm for interactive video world models, implemented with the Mixture-of-Bidirectional-and-Autoregressive ( MoBA ) attention. Mix Forcing jointly trains a video diffusion model with both teacher forcing and bidirectional training, yielding a strong causal initialization for few-step post-training. In self-attention, Mix Forcing leverages teacher forcing to learn causal next-chunk prediction for autoregressive rollout, while using bidirectional attention to preserve pretrained visual priors. To support online text interaction, Mix Forcing further adopts a chunk-wise cross-attention design that conditions each video chunk on a shared environment prompt and its own local prompt, without exposing future instructions to the current chunk. Following causal pre-training on a 14B image-to-video model, we apply consistency and distribution matching distillation to obtain a four-step autoregressive generator. Experiments on our internal benchmark and public benchmarks, including WBench and SANA-WM-Bench, show that our model achieves state-of-the-art visual quality and timely event following with precise camera control. Notably, our model supports high-fidelity long-horizon generation without quality degradation even over one-hour rollouts.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然交互式视频世界模型需要自回归生成，但直接通过教师强制将预训练的双向视频扩散模型改造为自回归模型，可能会破坏其视觉先验并降低自回归生成质量。 在本文中，我们提出了 Mix Forcing，一种面向交互式视频世界模型的因果预训练范式，并采用双向-自回归混合（MoBA）注意力加以实现。 Mix Forcing 通过教师强制和双向训练联合训练视频扩散模型，为少步后训练提供了强大的因果初始化。 在自注意力中，Mix Forcing 利用教师强制学习用于自回归推理的因果下一段预测，同时使用双向注意力以保留预训练的视觉先验。 为支持在线文本交互，Mix Forcing 进一步采用分块式交叉注意力设计，使每个视频块以共享的环境提示词及其自身的局部提示词为条件，而不会让未来的指令暴露给当前块。 在 14B 图生视频模型上进行因果预训练后，我们应用一致性与分布匹配蒸馏，得到一个四步自回归生成器。 在我们的内部基准以及包括 WBench 和 SANA-WM-Bench 在内的公开基准上的实验表明，我们的模型实现了最先进的视觉质量、及时的事件响应以及精确的相机控制。 值得注意的是，我们的模型支持高保真的长时程生成，即使在超过一小时的自回归推理中也不会出现质量退化。

paragraphs.en: Interactive video world models [ 19 , 34 , 10 , 49 , 53 , 33 , 14 , 47 ] , which predict future states conditioned on historical context and user inputs, have shown great potential for world simulation, video gaming, and embodied intelligence. Since users act based on past observations, each video chunk must be generated without access to future frames or future instructions, which calls for causal autoregressive generation.
paragraphs.zh: 交互式视频世界模型 [ 19 , 34 , 10 , 49 , 53 , 33 , 14 , 47 ] 基于历史上下文和用户输入来预测未来状态，在世界模拟、视频游戏和具身智能方面展现出巨大潜力。 由于用户基于过去的观察进行行动，每个视频片段的生成都不能访问未来帧或未来指令，这就需要因果自回归生成。

paragraphs.en: Recent works [ 34 , 53 , 14 ] build upon pretrained video diffusion models to leverage their strong visual priors. However, these priors are learned for bidirectional generation, where all frames are jointly denoised with access to both past and future frames. Some methods [ 16 , 43 ] directly distill bidirectional models into few-step causal generators via ordinary differential equation (ODE) initialization and distribution matching distillation (DMD), but the trajectories of the bidirectional teacher depend on future information, preventing the causal student from converging to the target flow map. To address this, other methods [ 54 , 50 ] first adapt pretrained models into many-step causal models with teacher forcing before few-step distillation, making this causal pre-training stage the foundation of the final generator.
paragraphs.zh: 近期工作 [ 34 , 53 , 14 ] 基于预训练视频扩散模型进行构建，以利用其强大的视觉先验。 然而，这些先验是为双向生成学习的，其中所有帧被联合去噪，并同时可以访问过去和未来的帧。 一些方法 [ 16 , 43 ] 通过常微分方程（ODE）初始化和分布匹配蒸馏（DMD），将双向模型直接蒸馏为少步因果生成器，但双向教师的轨迹依赖于未来信息，导致因果学生无法收敛到目标流映射。 为解决这一问题，其他方法 [ 54 , 50 ] 首先通过教师强制将预训练模型适配为多步因果模型，再进行少步蒸馏，使这一因果预训练阶段成为最终生成器的基础。

paragraphs.en: However, teacher forcing departs from the pretraining setting of bidirectional video diffusion models in two aspects. In attention, each chunk attends only to its history rather than the full video; in noise level, each noisy chunk is predicted from clean historical context rather than jointly denoised with other chunks at a shared noise level, which encourages velocity prediction to over-rely on clean context. Both deviations disrupt pretrained visual priors and degrade autoregressive generation quality. Moreover, causal pre-training methods typically condition the whole video on a single global prompt, which exposes future events to the current chunk. Streaming methods [ 40 ] support prompt updates by recaching the history under each new prompt, which rewrites the context of past frames.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，教师强制在两个方面偏离了双向视频扩散模型的预训练设定。 在注意力方面，每个片段仅关注其历史而非完整视频；在噪声水平方面，每个含噪片段是从干净的历史上下文中预测出来的，而不是与其他片段在同一噪声水平下联合去噪，这导致速度预测过度依赖干净上下文。 这两处偏离都会破坏预训练的视觉先验，并降低自回归生成的质量。 此外，因果预训练方法通常将整个视频条件在单一全局提示上，这会使未来事件暴露给当前片段。 流式方法 [ 40 ] 通过在每个新提示下重新缓存历史来支持提示更新，这会改写过去帧的上下文。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we introduce Mix Forcing , a causal pre-training paradigm for interactive video world models, implemented with the Mixture-of-Bidirectional-and-Autoregressive ( MoBA ) attention block. The key idea of Mix Forcing is to mix teacher forcing and bidirectional training: teacher forcing learns causal next-chunk prediction for autoregressive rollout, while bidirectional training retains the pretraining setting in both attention and noise level, preserving pretrained visual priors during causal adaptation. In addition, Mix Forcing conditions each teacher forcing chunk on a shared environment prompt and its own local prompt, enabling online text interaction without exposing future instructions to the current chunk or recomputing the KV cache of past chunks.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出 Mix Forcing，一种面向交互式视频世界模型的因果预训练范式，其通过混合双向与自回归（MoBA）注意力模块来实现。 Mix Forcing 的核心思想是将教师强制与双向训练相结合：教师强制学习用于自回归推理的因果式下一块预测，而双向训练在注意力和噪声水平上均保留预训练设置，从而在因果适配过程中保持预训练的视觉先验。 此外，Mix Forcing 让每个教师强制块以共享的环境提示及其自身的局部提示为条件，从而实现在线文本交互，同时无需将未来指令暴露给当前块，也无需重新计算过去块的 KV 缓存。

paragraphs.en: Based on Mix Forcing , we build an interactive video world model with camera control and online text interaction ( Fig. 1 ). Starting from a 14B image-to-video model, we perform causal pre-training with Mix Forcing , and then apply consistency distillation (CD) [ 31 ] and DMD to obtain a four-step generator for KV-cached autoregressive rollout ( Fig. 2 ). Experiments on our internal benchmark and public benchmarks show that our model achieves state-of-the-art visual quality and timely event following with precise camera control, and sustains high-fidelity generation over one-hour rollouts. Ablation studies further show that Mix Forcing provides a stronger initialization for few-step post-training than teacher forcing alone.
paragraphs.zh: 基于 Mix Forcing，我们构建了一个具备镜头控制和在线文本交互能力的交互式视频世界模型（图 1）。 从一个 14B 的图生视频模型出发，我们使用 Mix Forcing 进行因果预训练，然后应用一致性蒸馏（CD）[31] 和 DMD，得到一个用于 KV 缓存自回归推演的四步生成器（图 2）。 在我们的内部基准和公开基准上的实验表明，我们的模型实现了最先进的视觉质量和对事件 timely 的跟随能力，并具备精确的镜头控制，且能在超过一小时的推演中保持高保真生成。 消融实验进一步表明，与仅使用 teacher forcing 相比，Mix Forcing 为少步后训练提供了更强的初始化。

paragraphs.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 我们的贡献总结如下：

paragraphs.en: We propose the MoBA attention block, which mixes teacher forcing and bidirectional training to preserve pretrained visual priors during causal adaptation, with chunk-wise prompt conditioning for online text interaction.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 MoBA 注意力块，它混合了教师强制与双向训练，以在因果适配过程中保留预训练的视觉先验，并采用分块提示条件化以支持在线文本交互。

paragraphs.en: We build an interactive video world model through causal pre-training with Mix Forcing and few-step post-training with CD and DMD, supporting camera control, online text interaction, and four-step KV-cached autoregressive rollout.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过结合 Mix Forcing 的因果预训练与结合 CD 和 DMD 的少步后训练，构建了一个交互式视频世界模型，支持相机控制、在线文本交互以及四步 KV 缓存的自回归推演。

paragraphs.en: Experiments on internal and public benchmarks show that our model achieves state-of-the-art visual quality and timely event following with precise camera control.
paragraphs.zh: 在内部和公开基准测试上的实验表明，我们的模型实现了最先进的视觉质量，并能通过精确的摄像机控制及时跟随事件。

paragraphs.en: Interactive world models predict visual states conditioned on user actions [ 3 , 1 , 36 ] , while controllable video generation also supports text instructions and camera trajectories. Prior work incorporates camera geometry through ray representations [ 12 , 13 , 51 ] , trajectory embeddings [ 37 , 2 ] , or relative positional encodings [ 20 ] , enabling geometry-aware viewpoint control in video generation. Vid2World [ 15 ] adapts pretrained video diffusion for autoregressive action control, while LongLive [ 40 ] supports streaming prompt updates by recaching the history under each new prompt. MotionStream [ 30 ] supports interactive motion control during streaming video generation. Other video world models support interactive or long-horizon generation [ 45 , 4 , 14 , 33 , 34 , 53 , 10 , 49 ] . In this work, we aim to use causal pre-training for interactive video world models, maintaining the visual priors of pretrained video diffusion models while enabling online text interaction through chunk-wise conditioning.
paragraphs.zh: 交互式世界模型根据用户动作预测视觉状态 [ 3 , 1 , 36 ] ，而可控视频生成还支持文本指令和相机轨迹。 已有工作通过光线表示 [ 12 , 13 , 51 ] 、轨迹嵌入 [ 37 , 2 ] 或相对位置编码 [ 20 ] 引入相机几何信息，从而在视频生成中实现几何感知的视点控制。 Vid2World [ 15 ] 将预训练视频扩散模型改造为支持自回归动作控制的模型，而 LongLive [ 40 ] 通过在每个新提示下重新缓存历史信息来支持流式提示更新。 MotionStream [ 30 ] 在流式视频生成过程中支持交互式运动控制。 其他视频世界模型支持交互式或长时程生成 [ 45 , 4 , 14 , 33 , 34 , 53 , 10 , 49 ] 。 在本工作中，我们旨在利用因果预训练构建交互式视频世界模型，在保持预训练视频扩散模型视觉先验的同时，通过分块条件化实现在线文本交互。

sents.en: In this work, we aim to use causal pre-training for interactive video world models, maintaining the visual priors of pretrained video diffusion models while enabling online text interaction through chunk-wise conditioning.
sents.zh: 在本工作中，我们旨在利用因果预训练构建交互式视频世界模型，在保持预训练视频扩散模型视觉先验的同时，通过分块条件化实现在线文本交互。

paragraphs.en: Autoregressive video models generate frames or chunks sequentially [ 8 , 35 ] , with some using KV-cached streaming inference [ 29 , 19 ] . FramePack [ 46 ] compresses historical frames for long rollouts, while diffusion-forcing approaches assign varying noise levels across video frames [ 5 , 38 , 6 ] . To adapt pretrained bidirectional video diffusion models for online video rollout, prior methods initialize few-step causal students from probability-flow ODE trajectories [ 32 , 18 , 43 ] and subsequently improve them through distribution matching distillation [ 41 ] . Self Forcing [ 16 ] addresses rollout errors using self-generated history; Self-Forcing++ [ 7 ] and Self Gradient Forcing [ 55 ] extend this approach through teacher supervision on long self-generated rollouts and context-gradient reconstruction, respectively. Resampling Forcing [ 11 ] and Rolling Forcing [ 23 ] use self-resampling and joint denoising, respectively. Causal Forcing [ 54 ] and Causal Forcing++ [ 50 ] improve few-step distillation using a causal teacher and causal consistency distillation, respectively. Reward Forcing [ 25 ] uses reward-weighted distribution matching distillation for streaming video generation. In Mix Forcing , we jointly optimize teacher forcing and bidirectional attention during causal pre-training to retain pretrained visual priors before few-step post-training.
paragraphs.zh: 自回归视频模型按顺序生成帧或帧块 [8, 35]，其中一些方法使用带 KV 缓存的流式推理 [29, 19]。 FramePack [46] 压缩历史帧以支持长时程展开，而扩散强制（diffusion forcing）类方法则为视频各帧分配不同的噪声水平 [5, 38, 6]。 为了将预训练的双向视频扩散模型适配到在线视频生成中，已有方法先从概率流 ODE 轨迹初始化少步因果学生模型 [32, 18, 43]，随后通过分布匹配蒸馏对其进行改进 [41]。 Self Forcing [16] 利用自生成的历史来应对展开误差；Self-Forcing++ [7] 和 Self Gradient Forcing [55] 分别通过在长时程自生成展开上的教师监督以及上下文梯度重建来扩展这一方法。 Resampling Forcing [11] 和 Rolling Forcing [23] 分别使用自重采样和联合去噪。 Causal Forcing [54] 和 Causal Forcing++ [50] 分别借助因果教师和因果一致性蒸馏来改进少步蒸馏。 Reward Forcing [25] 使用奖励加权的分布匹配蒸馏来实现流式视频生成。 在 Mix Forcing 中，我们在因果预训练阶段联合优化教师强制与双向注意力，以便在少步后训练之前保留预训练的视觉先验。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we present Mix Forcing , a causal pre-training paradigm for interactive video world models. We first review flow matching and teacher forcing for interactive video modeling ( Sec. 3.1 ). We then introduce the MoBA attention block that implements Mix Forcing , which mixes teacher forcing and bidirectional training to preserve pretrained visual priors, with chunk-wise prompt conditioning for online text interaction ( Sec. 3.2 ). Finally, as shown in Fig. 2 , we apply Mix Forcing to build an interactive video world model with camera control and online text interaction ( Sec. 3.3 ).

paragraphs.en: We initialize our interactive video world model from a pretrained bidirectional video model and apply Mix Forcing for causal pre-training. For camera control, we represent the camera pose 𝐞 i \mathbf{e}_{i} of chunk i i with Plücker embeddings [ 12 , 13 ] , which encode the viewing ray of each pixel as six-dimensional coordinates. Following [ 10 , 34 ] , we inject them through adaptive layer normalization (AdaLN) [ 39 ] without disrupting the pretrained visual priors. During causal pre-training, we jointly train our model with camera-labeled and unlabeled data. For unlabeled data, we use an all-zero dummy Plücker embedding as the condition input. As a result, a bidirectional video diffusion model is converted into an interactive video model supporting camera control and multi-step autoregressive rollout with KV cache.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从一个预训练的双向视频模型初始化我们的交互式视频世界模型，并应用 Mix Forcing 进行因果预训练。 对于相机控制，我们使用 Plücker 嵌入 [12, 13] 来表示片段 i 的相机位姿 𝐞 i \mathbf{e}_{i}，该嵌入将每个像素的视线光线编码为六维坐标。 遵循 [10, 34]，我们通过自适应层归一化（AdaLN）[39] 注入它们，而不会破坏预训练的视觉先验。 在因果预训练期间，我们使用带相机标注和未标注的数据联合训练我们的模型。 对于未标注数据，我们使用全零的占位 Plücker 嵌入作为条件输入。 这样，一个双向视频扩散模型就被转换为一个支持相机控制和基于 KV 缓存的多步自回归展开的交互式视频模型。

paragraphs.en: We construct an internal benchmark (InBench) to evaluate event-following ability and camera-control precision. We use GPT-Image 2.5 [ 27 ] to generate 96 initial images and organize InBench into two subsets: (i) an interactive subset covering environmental changes and character interactions (32 cases); and (ii) a roaming subset covering human characters and virtual objects (64 cases). Each case is evaluated with a video of 8 to 35 seconds, and each interactive case contains 3 to 5 prompt updates. We also evaluate on WBench [ 44 ] and SANA-WM-Bench [ 53 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 我们构建了一个内部基准（InBench），用于评估事件跟随能力和相机控制精度。 我们使用 GPT-Image 2.5 [27] 生成 96 张初始图像，并将 InBench 组织为两个子集：（i）交互子集，涵盖环境变化和角色交互（32 个案例）；（ii）漫游子集，涵盖人类角色和虚拟物体（64 个案例）。 每个案例通过一段 8 到 35 秒的视频进行评估，每个交互案例包含 3 到 5 次提示词更新。 我们还在 WBench [44] 和 SANA-WM-Bench [53] 上进行了评估。

paragraphs.en: Following WBench and SANA-WM-Bench, we report aesthetic quality (AQ), imaging quality (IQ), temporal flickering (TFlk), and dynamic degree (DD) from VBench [ 17 ] , HPSv3 [ 26 ] , and rotation error (Rot, in radians), translation error (Trans), and camera-motion consistency (CMC) between the input and estimated camera trajectories. For long rollouts, IQ a ​ – ​ b \mathrm{IQ}_{a\text{--}b} denotes imaging quality from a a to b b seconds, and sustained imaging quality (SIQ) averages the first and last windows. For online text interaction, we use a vision-language model as a judge [ 52 ] to measure Event Adherence (EA), the completion of each event, and On-Time Accuracy (OT), whether a correct response appears within a given time after each prompt update (see Appendix).
paragraphs.zh: 参照 WBench 和 SANA-WM-Bench，我们报告来自 VBench [17] 的美学质量（AQ）、成像质量（IQ）、时间闪烁（TFlk）和动态程度（DD），HPSv3 [26]，以及输入相机轨迹与估计相机轨迹之间的旋转误差（Rot，单位为弧度）、平移误差（Trans）和相机运动一致性（CMC）。 对于长时段展开，IQ_{a--b} 表示从第 a 秒到第 b 秒的成像质量，而持续成像质量（SIQ）对首尾两个时间窗口取平均。 对于在线文本交互，我们使用一个视觉语言模型作为评判者 [52] 来衡量事件 adherence（EA，即每个事件的完成情况）和准时准确率（OT，即每次提示更新后是否在给定时间内出现正确响应，见附录）。

paragraphs.en: We train on 100k self-collected clips (974 hours), 70% of which have camera poses estimated by COLMAP [ 28 ] , while the rest use the dummy Plücker embedding ( Sec. 3.3 ). For causal pre-training, we initialize from Wan2.1-I2V-14B-480P, train on variable-length 480 × 832 480\times 832 videos at 16 FPS with λ TF = λ BID = 1 \lambda_{\mathrm{TF}}=\lambda_{\mathrm{BID}}=1 , and use AdamW with a learning rate decaying from 5e-5 to 1e-5; the chunk sizes for teacher forcing and chunk-wise cross-attention are 1 and 4 latent frames, respectively. We randomly perturb the clean context latents using low-level noise with 50% probability [ 19 ] . For post-training, CD uses LPIPS [ 48 ] as the distance metric with a learning rate of 2e-6, and DMD follows LingBot-World-Fast with LingBot-World-Base [ 34 ] as score models. All three stages use 256 H20 GPUs, with 15k, 8k, and 1.5k steps for pre-training, CD, and DMD.

paragraphs.en: Tab. 1 shows that our model achieves the best average quality, event-following, and camera-control results among all methods. paragraphs.en: We report SANA-WM-Bench results in Tab. 2 . On both the simple and hard 60-second splits, our model achieves the highest average Quality (74.8 and 74.7) and SIQ (66.7 and 66.4) scores, whereas several baselines show clear quality drops in later windows, e.g., the IQ of LingBot-World-Fast decreases from 63.2 to 52.0 on the simple split. These results demonstrate that our model maintains visual fidelity throughout minute-long autoregressive generation; one-hour qualitative results and average quality scores measured every five minutes are further provided in Figure. S12 in the Appendix. Although competitive, our camera errors are not the lowest on SANA-WM-Bench. We partly attribute this gap to a prompt mismatch: the benchmark describes the entire video with a single global prompt, whereas our model is trained with an environment prompt and chunk-wise local prompts. Although local prompts do not explicitly specify camera motion, they indicate what should appear in the current chunk and thus help the pose condition control viewpoints more precisely, as supported by the reduced camera errors with chunk-wise prompts in Tab. 4 . We further evaluate on the Navi-158 subset of WBench (Table. S1 in the Appendix), where our model achieves the highest average Quality (78.5) and Setting adherence (80.3) scores, indicating strong visual fidelity and faithful reflection of the specified world settings, while its Interaction scores show a gap similar to that of the camera errors on SANA-WM-Bench.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在表 2 中报告了 SANA-WM-Bench 的结果。 在简单和困难两个 60 秒切分上，我们的模型均取得了最高的平均 Quality（74.8 和 74.7）和 SIQ（66.7 和 66.4）分数，而若干基线模型在后续窗口中出现明显的质量下降，例如 LingBot-World-Fast 在简单切分上的 IQ 从 63.2 降至 52.0。 这些结果表明，我们的模型在长达一分钟的自回归生成过程中始终保持视觉保真度；一小时级别的定性结果以及每五分钟测量的平均质量分数进一步在附录的图 S12 中给出。 尽管具有竞争力，我们的相机误差在 SANA-WM-Bench 上并非最低。 我们将这一差距部分归因于提示词不匹配：该基准使用单一全局提示词描述整个视频，而我们的模型则使用环境提示词和分块的局部提示词进行训练。 尽管局部提示词并未显式指定相机运动，但它们指出了当前分块中应出现的内容，从而帮助位姿条件更精确地控制视角，表 4 中使用分块提示词时相机误差降低的结果也支持了这一点。 我们进一步在 WBench 的 Navi-158 子集上进行评估（表 附录中的 S1），我们的模型在该子集上取得了最高的平均 Quality（78.5）和 Setting adherence（80.3）分数，表明其具备强大的视觉保真度并忠实反映了指定的世界设定，而其 Interaction 分数则显示出与 SANA-WM-Bench 上相机误差类似的差距。

paragraphs.en: To complement these automatic metrics, we further conduct a pairwise user study. Participants compare our model with one baseline at a time in a method-blinded, side-by-side setting, rating visual quality on all cases, interactive following on the interactive subset, and motion clarity on the roaming subset. We collect 318 pairwise trials from 18 sessions, with details provided in the Appendix. As shown in Fig. 4 , participants consistently prefer our model over each baseline in terms of visual quality, interactive following, and motion clarity.
paragraphs.zh: 为了补充这些自动指标，我们进一步开展了一项成对用户研究。 参与者在方法盲测、并排对比的设置下，每次将我们的模型与一个基线进行比较，对所有案例的视觉质量、交互子集上的交互跟随性以及漫游子集上的运动清晰度进行评分。 我们从18个会话中收集了318次成对试验，详细信息见附录。 如图4所示，参与者在视觉质量、交互跟随性和运动清晰度方面一致地更偏好我们的模型而非各个基线。

paragraphs.en: Fig. 5 5(a) illustrates the qualitative comparison on the InBench roaming subset. During camera movement, especially when the viewpoint changes, the video model needs to generate the visual content from a novel perspective while keeping its structure and appearance stable across frames. We observe that existing state-of-the-art methods suffer from progressive blurring and structural distortion, recovering sharpness only after the camera stops moving. In contrast, the enlarged regions highlighted by yellow boxes show that our model better maintains scene consistency, motion clarity, and fine-grained appearance throughout the viewpoint transition.
paragraphs.zh: 图5(a)展示了在InBench漫游子集上的定性比较结果。 在相机移动过程中，尤其是视角发生变化时，视频模型需要从新视角生成视觉内容，同时保持结构和外观在各帧间稳定。 我们观察到，现有的最先进方法会出现渐进式模糊和结构扭曲，只有在相机停止移动后才能恢复清晰度。 相比之下，黄色框中放大的区域表明，我们的模型在整个视角过渡过程中更好地保持了场景一致性、运动清晰度和细粒度外观。

paragraphs.en: Fig. 5 5(b) illustrates the qualitative comparison on the InBench interactive subset. paragraphs.en: Using teacher forcing (TF) as the baseline, we evaluate the effects of adding diffusion forcing (DF) [ 5 ] and bidirectional (BID) training. As shown in Tab. 3 , TF+BID (row 4) improves generation quality, achieves the highest SIQ of 58.4, and maintains high final-window quality (from IQ 0–2 =55.9 to IQ 8–10 =61.0), while IQ drops from 51.5 to 48.3 under TF, indicating that bidirectional attention can mitigate quality degradation. However, adding DF (rows 2 and 3) can reduce generation quality. We attribute this degradation to a mismatch between training and inference, where DF uses noisy historical chunks during training, while KV-cached inference leverages fully denoised historical context. Note that DF replaces the clean history with independently noised history, which matches neither the clean KV cache at inference nor the shared noise level of pretraining. In contrast, MoBA keeps the clean history in TF for inference consistency and recovers the pretraining setting in a separate BID branch. We further study the effect of training chunk size under TF+BID. As chunk size=1 (row 4) enables fine-grained causal modeling by assigning an independent noise level to each latent frame and outperforms the other settings (rows 5 and 6) in both generation quality and camera control accuracy, we combine TF and BID training with chunk size=1 in MoBA .
paragraphs.zh: 以教师强制（TF）作为基线，我们评估了加入扩散强制（DF）[5] 与双向（BID）训练的效果。 如表 3 所示，TF+BID（第 4 行）提升了生成质量，达到最高的 SIQ 58.4，并保持了较高的末窗口质量（从 IQ 0–2 =55.9 到 IQ 8–10 =61.0），而 TF 下 IQ 从 51.5 降至 48.3，表明双向注意力可以缓解质量退化。 然而，加入 DF（第 2 行和第 3 行）会降低生成质量。 我们将这种退化归因于训练与推理之间的不匹配：DF 在训练期间使用带噪声的历史块，而基于 KV 缓存的推理则利用完全去噪的历史上下文。 注意，DF 用独立加噪的历史替换干净历史，这既不匹配推理时的干净 KV 缓存，也不匹配预训练时的共享噪声水平。 相比之下，MoBA 在 TF 中保留干净历史以保证推理一致性，并在单独的 BID 分支中恢复预训练设置。 我们进一步研究了 TF+BID 下训练块大小的影响。 由于块大小=1（第 4 行）通过为每个潜在帧分配独立的噪声水平实现了细粒度的因果建模，并在生成质量和相机控制精度上均优于其他设置（第 5 行和第 6 行），因此我们在 MoBA 中将 TF 与 BID 训练结合并采用块大小=1。

paragraphs.en: We present Mix Forcing , a causal pre-training paradigm for interactive video world models. Implemented with the MoBA attention block, it mixes teacher forcing and bidirectional training to preserve pretrained visual priors, and uses chunk-wise prompts for online text interaction. Combined with CD and DMD, our four-step model achieves state-of-the-art visual quality and timely event following with camera control over one-hour rollouts.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 Mix Forcing，这是一种面向交互式视频世界模型的因果预训练范式。 该方法基于 MoBA 注意力模块实现，将教师强制与双向训练相结合以保留预训练的视觉先验，并使用分块提示实现在线文本交互。 结合 CD 与 DMD，我们的四步模型实现了最先进的视觉质量和对事件的及时跟随，并支持超过一小时的相机控制长程推演。

sents.en: We present Mix Forcing , a causal pre-training paradigm for interactive video world models.
sents.zh: 我们提出 Mix Forcing，这是一种面向交互式视频世界模型的因果预训练范式。

sents.en: Implemented with the MoBA attention block, it mixes teacher forcing and bidirectional training to preserve pretrained visual priors, and uses chunk-wise prompts for online text interaction.
sents.zh: 该方法基于 MoBA 注意力模块实现，将教师强制与双向训练相结合以保留预训练的视觉先验，并使用分块提示实现在线文本交互。

sents.en: Combined with CD and DMD, our four-step model achieves state-of-the-art visual quality and timely event following with camera control over one-hour rollouts.

paragraphs.en: Our implementation targets video DiT architectures with separate self-attention and cross-attention modules, and its extension to unified attention [ 21 ] remains to be verified. Moreover, our model is designed for chunk-wise local prompts, and its camera control is less precise when only a single global prompt is available, as observed on public benchmarks. We leave these directions for future work.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的实现面向具有独立自注意力与交叉注意力模块的视频 DiT 架构，其向统一注意力 [ 21 ] 的扩展仍有待验证。 此外，我们的模型是为分块局部提示设计的，当仅有单个全局提示可用时，其相机控制的精度较低，这一点在公开基准上有所体现。 我们将这些方向留待未来工作。

A vision-language model assesses the remaining clips for editing artifacts, viewpoint, and interaction content.

paragraphs.en: For each clip, we generate a shared environment prompt describing the scene and a global prompt summarizing the entire video. We separately annotate subject visibility, motion, interactions, and environmental changes, then combine the active annotations into local prompts. We refine these prompts for consistent wording and temporal alignment, removing descriptions of future events or actions unsupported by visual evidence. Each local prompt is shared by four consecutive latent frames, consistent with the cross-attention setting in the main paper.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个片段，我们生成一个描述场景的共享环境提示词，以及一个总结整个视频的全局提示词。 我们分别标注主体的可见性、运动、交互和环境变化，然后将处于激活状态的标注组合为局部提示词。 我们对这些提示词进行细化，以确保措辞一致和时间对齐，并删除缺乏视觉证据支持的、关于未来事件或动作的描述。 每个局部提示词由四个连续的潜在帧共享，这与正文中交叉注意力设置保持一致。

paragraphs.en: We initialize our model from Wan2.1-I2V-14B-480P and train on variable-length videos at 16 FPS with a resolution of 480 × 832 480\times 832 . We train for 15k steps on 512 H200 GPUs using AdamW with a learning rate of 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} decaying to 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} . TF and BID are jointly optimized in a single forward pass with equal loss weights, λ TF = λ BID = 1.0 \lambda_{\mathrm{TF}}=\lambda_{\mathrm{BID}}=1.0 . Under TF, we use chunk size=1 and independently sample a timestep for each latent frame, while BID uses a shared timestep for the entire video. We set the flow shift to 5. We perturb the clean historical context with low-level noise with 50% probability to improve robustness during autoregressive rollout [ 19 ] .

sents.zh: 在 TF 下，我们使用 chunk size=1，并为每个潜在帧独立采样一个时间步，而 BID 则对整个视频使用共享的时间步。

sents.en: We set the flow shift to 5.
sents.zh: 我们将 flow shift 设为 5。

sents.en: We perturb the clean historical context with low-level noise with 50% probability to improve robustness during autoregressive rollout [ 19 ] .
sents.zh: 我们以 50% 的概率用低强度噪声扰动干净的历史上下文，以提升自回归推演过程中的鲁棒性 [ 19 ] 。

paragraphs.en: We use the causal pre-trained model as the teacher to distill a four-step generator. We fully fine-tune the video backbone and camera-control modules, using chunk size=4 latent frames and conditioning on one initial frame. We optimize the student for 8k steps on 512 H20 GPUs using AdamW with a learning rate of 2 × 10 − 6 2\times 10^{-6} , ( β 1 , β 2 ) = ( 0 , 0.999 ) (\beta_{1},\beta_{2})=(0,0.999) , and no learning-rate warm-up. The target model is maintained as an exponential moving average of the student parameters with a decay rate of 0.99. We set N = 48 N=48 for discrete CD and use a guidance scale of 3.0. We replace use LPIPS as CD loss.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用因果预训练模型作为教师，蒸馏出四步生成器。 我们对视频骨干网络和相机控制模块进行全量微调，使用块大小为 4 个潜空间帧，并以一帧初始帧作为条件。 我们使用 AdamW 在 512 块 H20 GPU 上对学生模型优化 8k 步，学习率为 2 × 10 − 6 2\times 10^{-6}，( β 1 , β 2 ) = ( 0 , 0.999 ) (\beta_{1},\beta_{2})=(0,0.999)，且不使用学习率预热。 目标模型以学生参数的指数移动平均形式维护，衰减率为 0.99。 对于离散 CD，我们设置 N = 48 N=48，并使用 3.0 的引导尺度。 我们改为使用 LPIPS 作为 CD 损失。

sents.zh: 我们使用 AdamW 在 512 块 H20 GPU 上对学生模型优化 8k 步，学习率为 2 × 10 − 6 2\times 10^{-6}，( β 1 , β 2 ) = ( 0 , 0.999 ) (\beta_{1},\beta_{2})=(0,0.999)，且不使用学习率预热。

paragraphs.en: We further refine the four-step generator obtained from CD using DMD for 1.5k steps on 512 H20 GPUs. We retain the same four-step schedule with timestep indices { 0,250,500,750 } \{0,250,500,750\} . We use LingBot-World-Base [ 34 ] for the real and fake score models. The real score model remains fixed, while the fake score model is updated with the standard diffusion loss on generated videos. The generator is optimized using the distribution matching objective described in the main paper. We set the learning rates to 2 × 10 − 6 2\times 10^{-6} for the generator and 4 × 10 − 7 4\times 10^{-7} for the fake score model, with ( β 1 , β 2 ) = ( 0 , 0.999 ) (\beta_{1},\beta_{2})=(0,0.999) for both optimizers. The fake score model is updated at every training step, while the generator is updated once every five steps.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进一步使用 DMD 在 512 块 H20 GPU 上对通过 CD 得到的四步生成器进行 1.5k 步的微调。 我们保留相同的四步调度，时间步索引为 {0,250,500,750}。 我们使用 LingBot-World-Base [34] 作为真实和伪评分模型。 真实评分模型保持固定，而伪评分模型通过在生成视频上使用标准扩散损失进行更新。 生成器使用主论文中描述的分布匹配目标进行优化。 我们将生成器的学习率设为 2×10⁻⁶，伪评分模型的学习率设为 4×10⁻⁷，两个优化器均使用 (β₁,β₂)=(0,0.999)。 伪评分模型在每个训练步都进行更新，而生成器每五步更新一次。

paragraphs.en: We adopt the quality metrics from VBench [ 17 ] and WBench [ 44 ] , and the camera-error metrics from SANA-WM-Bench [ 53 ] . On InBench, quality is evaluated on the full benchmark, while camera errors are evaluated on the roaming subset. Quality scores are reported on a 0–100 scale, with higher values indicating better performance; lower camera errors indicate more accurate control.
paragraphs.zh: 我们采用 VBench [17] 和 WBench [44] 的质量指标，以及 SANA-WM-Bench [53] 的相机误差指标。 在 InBench 上，质量在整个基准上进行评估，而相机误差则在漫游子集上进行评估。 质量分数以 0–100 分制报告，数值越高表示性能越好；相机误差越低表示控制越精确。

paragraphs.en: AQ evaluates the visual appeal of generated frames, including composition, color, and lighting. The LAION aesthetic predictor scores the normalized CLIP ViT-L/14 features of each sampled frame. We average these frame scores within each video and multiply the result by 10 to convert the original 0–10 scale to 0–100.
paragraphs.zh: AQ 评估生成帧的视觉吸引力，包括构图、色彩和光照。 LAION 美学预测器对每个采样帧的归一化 CLIP ViT-L/14 特征进行评分。 我们对每个视频内的这些帧分数取平均值，并将结果乘以 10，把原始的 0–10 分制转换为 0–100。

sents.en: AQ evaluates the visual appeal of generated frames, including composition, color, and lighting.
sents.zh: AQ 评估生成帧的视觉吸引力，包括构图、色彩和光照。

sents.en: The LAION aesthetic predictor scores the normalized CLIP ViT-L/14 features of each sampled frame.

sents.zh: 我们对每个视频内的这些帧分数取平均值，并将结果乘以 10，把原始的 0–10 分制转换为 0–100。

paragraphs.en: IQ evaluates frame quality, including sharpness, noise, and visual artifacts. We use MUSIQ, a no-reference image-quality model, to score each sampled frame after resizing its longer edge to at most 512 pixels. The video score is the mean of the frame scores on the 0–100 scale.
paragraphs.zh: IQ 评估帧的质量，包括清晰度、噪声和视觉伪影。 我们使用 MUSIQ（一种无参考图像质量模型）对每个采样帧进行打分，打分前先将帧较长边缩放至不超过 512 像素。 视频得分是各帧得分在 0–100 分制上的平均值。

sents.zh: IQ 评估帧的质量，包括清晰度、噪声和视觉伪影。

paragraphs.en: TFlk measures frame-to-frame appearance variation using the mean absolute pixel difference between consecutive evaluated frames. Let d ¯ \bar{d} denote this difference averaged over frame pairs, spatial locations, and color channels, with pixel values in [ 0,255 ] [0,255] . paragraphs.en: DD measures the proportion of generated videos containing substantial motion. We estimate optical flow between consecutive sampled frames using RAFT and average the largest 5% of flow magnitudes for each pair. Following the official implementation, the motion threshold is 6 ​ min ⁡ ( H , W ) / 256 6\min(H,W)/256 , where H H and W W are the frame dimensions after preprocessing. A video with N N sampled frames is classified as dynamic if at least max ⁡ ( 1 , round ⁡ ( N / 4 ) ) \max(1,\operatorname{round}(N/4)) frame pairs exceed this threshold. DD is the percentage of videos classified as dynamic.
paragraphs.zh: DD 衡量生成的视频中包含明显运动的比例。 我们使用 RAFT 估计相邻采样帧之间的光流，并对每对帧取最大的 5% 光流幅值求平均。 按照官方实现，运动阈值为 6 min(H,W)/256，其中 H 和 W 是预处理后的帧的尺寸。 对于包含 N 个采样帧的视频，如果至少有 max(1, round(N/4)) 个帧对超过该阈值，则将其分类为动态视频。 DD 是被分类为动态的视频所占的百分比。

paragraphs.en: Temporal IQ evaluates how imaging quality changes during autoregressive rollout by applying the same IQ metric to different time windows. For the 10-second ablation videos, we evaluate the first and last two seconds, denoted by IQ 0 ​ – ​ 2 \mathrm{IQ}_{0\text{--}2} and IQ 8 ​ – ​ 10 \mathrm{IQ}_{8\text{--}10} . For the 60-second SANA-WM-Bench videos, we use IQ 0 ​ – ​ 10 \mathrm{IQ}_{0\text{--}10} and IQ 50 ​ – ​ 60 \mathrm{IQ}_{50\text{--}60} . In both settings, SIQ is the arithmetic mean of the first- and last-window IQ scores. We report both window scores alongside SIQ to show the change in quality over time.
paragraphs.zh: 时间智能体智商（Temporal IQ）通过将相同的图像质量（IQ）指标应用于不同的时间窗口，来评估图像质量在自回归生成过程中的变化。 对于10秒的消融视频，我们评估开头和结尾各两秒的内容，记为 \mathrm{IQ}_{0\text{--}2} 和 \mathrm{IQ}_{8\text{--}10}。 对于60秒的 SANA-WM-Bench 视频，我们使用 \mathrm{IQ}_{0\text{--}10} 和 \mathrm{IQ}_{50\text{--}60}。 在这两种设置中，SIQ 均为首个和末个时间窗口 IQ 分数的算术平均值。 我们在报告 SIQ 的同时报告这两个窗口的分数，以展示图像质量随时间的变化。

paragraphs.en: Each trial compares our model with one of five baselines: HY-WorldPlay, JoyAI-Echo-WM, LingBot-World-Fast, Matrix-Game 3.0, and SANA-WM-Streaming. The two videos use the same initial image and source control sequence and are displayed side by side at the same size using the 480p evaluation outputs. Model identities and numerical evaluation scores are hidden from participants.

paragraphs.en: The study uses the full InBench case pool, comprising 96 cases: 64 roaming cases and 32 interactive cases. Each session contains 20 pairs of videos (40 videos in total), corresponding to 10 interactive cases and 10 roaming cases, with no case repeated within a session. Each baseline appears in four trials per session. We shuffle the baseline assignments and select cases within each subset, prioritizing case–baseline pairs with fewer previous assignments. The two subsets are presented in separate blocks, and no case is repeated within a session.

paragraphs.en: Tab. S1 reports the complete results on the Navi-158 subset of WBench [ 44 ] , covering generation quality, setting adherence, and navigation performance. Our model achieves the highest average Quality and Setting scores of 78.5 and 80.3, respectively. It also obtains the highest AQ, IQ, HPSv3, and subject-adherence scores, indicating strong visual quality and adherence to the specified subjects. The average Interaction score is 84.3. We attribute this gap partly to a mismatch between the global prompts used in WBench and the chunk-wise prompt conditioning used in our cross-attention. This interpretation is supported by the cross-attention ablation in the main paper, where chunk-wise prompts reduce all three camera errors compared with global prompts.
paragraphs.zh: 表格。 表 S1 报告了 WBench [44] 的 Navi-158 子集上的完整结果，涵盖生成质量、场景一致性和导航性能。 我们的模型取得了最高的平均质量分数和场景分数，分别为 78.5 和 80.3。 它还获得了最高的 AQ、IQ、HPSv3 和主体一致性分数，表明其具有很强的视觉质量和对指定主体的遵循能力。 平均交互分数为 84.3。 我们将这一差距部分归因于 WBench 中使用的全局提示词与我们的交叉注意力中使用的分块提示词条件化之间的不匹配。 正文中的交叉注意力消融实验支持了这一解释，该实验表明与全局提示词相比，分块提示词降低了所有三项相机误差。

paragraphs.en: Figs. S2 to S10 compare our interactive video world model with HY-WorldPlay, JoyAI-Echo-WM, Matrix-Game 3.0, SANA-WM-Streaming, and LingBot-World-Fast on 18 selected InBench cases. For each case, we show five frames at the same generated-video timestamps across all methods, with summaries of the active event instructions above the columns. For roaming cases, the five frames are sampled uniformly over the full video duration. The examples include environmental changes, character actions, and exploration across diverse scenes. In the portal, rainbow, and ocean-view room examples, our model responds to the requested events while retaining recognizable scene content. The roaming examples further illustrate subject and scene consistency during camera motion.
paragraphs.zh: 图S2至S10 在18个选定的InBench案例上，将我们的交互式视频世界模型与HY-WorldPlay、JoyAI-Echo-WM、Matrix-Game 3.0、SANA-WM-Streaming和LingBot-World-Fast进行了比较。 对于每个案例，我们展示了所有方法在相同生成视频时间戳下的五帧，并在各列上方给出了当前事件指令的摘要。 对于漫游案例，五帧是在整个视频时长内均匀采样的。 这些示例包括环境变化、角色动作以及跨多样场景的探索。 在传送门、彩虹和海景房的示例中，我们的模型在响应所请求事件的同时，保留了可识别的场景内容。 漫游示例进一步说明了相机运动过程中主体和场景的一致性。
